query: SELECT performance_on_hotpotqa, evaluation_metric, evaluation_dataset FROM cspaper WHERE performance_on_hotpotqa != 'Clean ACC: Mistral-7B 51.0, Llama2-C 46.0, GPT-4o 47.6; Robust RACC/ASR (PIA Attack, AVF α=5): Mistral-7B 53.0/8.0, Llama2-C 34.0/11.4, GPT-4o 42.6/9.8' AND agent_framework != 'Multi-Agent Collaboration';
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。

nodes.detail: performance_on_hotpotqa <> 'Clean ACC: Mistral-7B 51.0, Llama2-C 46.0, GPT-4o 47.6; Robust RACC/ASR (PIA Attack, AVF α=5): Mistral-7B 53.0/8.0, Llama2-C 34.0/11.4, GPT-4o 42.6/9.8' AND agent_framework <> 'Multi-Agent Collaboration'
逻辑补出的原文抽取；agent_framework, evaluation_dataset, evaluation_metric, performance_on_hotpotqa
cspaper 对应原始文档集合
